name: lawh.ai
description:
Lawh.ai turns a description into a real design file — not a flat image.

Describe what you need and Claude builds it directly in your Lawh.ai account: an
Instagram post, a sale poster, a hiring ad, an event flyer. What lands is a proper
layered document you can keep working on — every headline, shape, and image is a
separate layer you can drag, restyle, or rewrite in Lawh's browser editor, and the
whole thing exports to a layered PSD for Photoshop.

The difference from asking a model for a picture is that Lawh does the part models
are bad at. Its layout engine measures every line of text at its real rendered size
and computes exact positions, so nothing overlaps and no word gets cut off. It then
audits the result for collisions, off-canvas layers, and unreadable colour contrast,
and hands the findings back to Claude — which is how Claude can spot and fix its own
mistakes without ever seeing the picture.

Full right-to-left support: Arabic, Hebrew, Farsi, and Urdu designs are laid out
properly, anchored to the correct edge, with Arabic-capable typefaces.

You can also start from Lawh's hand-authored template library instead of a blank
canvas, and pull in logos and images you have already uploaded so designs use your
real brand assets rather than placeholders.

Designs created through this connector do not consume Lawh AI credits — Claude does
the generating, so there is no AI cost on our side to pass on. Paid plans get
unlimited connector designs within their storage limit; free accounts get 30 a month.

Requires a Lawh.ai account (free to create). Connecting takes one click and a sign-in.

_published_faq.name: How do I add lawh.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add lawh.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://lawh.ai/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is lawh.ai MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, lawh.ai scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the lawh.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: lawh.ai lists 13 MCP tools, including create_design, create_folder, create_from_template, design_guide, design_studio, get_design, list_designs, list_folders, list_media, list_templates, move_design, and preview_design.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to lawh.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to lawh.ai in creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Clipkit, Backstage, Interior Company, vivideo-prompt-builder, and gpt-war.
lawh.ai does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

acceptedAnswer.text: lawh.ai scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
